increments.title: Direction-aware normalized Shadowblade dash
increments.note: Cardinal/diagonal normalization and safe neutral/nonfinite fallback are implemented and covered by deterministic tests. Existing Win32 Q and Thought Command call sites still use the one-argument forward fallback, so directional live input integration is intentionally not claimed in this pass.

increments.title: Deterministic attack combo tracking
increments.note: Successful existing light/heavy attacks update combo/best-combo state; timeout and rejected attempts do not inflate it. No new HUD presentation is claimed.

increments.title: Posture, stagger, and recovery
increments.note: Existing light/heavy attacks now apply bounded posture, trigger a finite stagger opening, recover posture after idle delay, and clear stagger on defeat.

increments.title: Stagger-earned Fatal Strike follow-up
increments.note: Existing Fatal Strike recognizes an active stagger opening, uses a reduced 30-resource follow-up cost, and consumes that opening only after range/resource checks pass. Damage and cooldown remain unchanged.

increments.title: Ordered National Mall objective guidance state
increments.note: Landmark discovery keeps free exploration but exposes ordered Lincoln -> Reflecting Pool -> Washington Monument progression. Existing UI does not yet present the next objective.

increments.title: Resettable training-session combat metrics
increments.note: CombatSandbox records total damage, hits, peak hit, best combo, and exposes an idempotent session reset. No runtime key/UI is added in this bounded pass, so player-visible reset/metrics are not claimed.

community_source.request: A training target/tool that reports total damage and combat statistics for build and rotation testing.
community_source.evidence_limit: Original player post and discussion, not a community consensus measurement. Discussion also cautions that training-dummy optimization does not reproduce interruption-heavy real combat.

next_action: Open the bounded PR, verify hosted Windows compile/tests and exact-head independent review, address findings, then merge only if those gates pass. Carry player-visible dash direction, objective HUD, and training reset/metrics presentation into a later coordinated input/UI packet.
